# CNBC
> CNBC is a business news and financial media site covering markets, the economy, companies, investing, and personal finance.

CNBC publishes real-time market coverage, breaking business news, analysis, video programming, and topic-specific reporting across industries including technology, energy, healthcare, media, transportation, and real estate.

## Main Coverage
- [CNBC Home](https://www.cnbc.com/): Front page for breaking business news, markets coverage, and featured analysis.
- [Markets](https://www.cnbc.com/markets/): Market news, indexes, futures, bonds, currencies, commodities, and trading coverage.
- [Business](https://www.cnbc.com/business/): Corporate news, earnings, dealmaking, leadership, and industry developments.
- [Investing](https://www.cnbc.com/investing/): Investing news, stock ideas, portfolio themes, and market strategy coverage.
- [Economy](https://www.cnbc.com/economy/): Inflation, jobs, GDP, central banks, trade, and macroeconomic reporting.
- [Politics](https://www.cnbc.com/politics/): U.S. policy, regulation, elections, Washington, and government business impact.
- [Technology](https://www.cnbc.com/technology/): Tech companies, AI, semiconductors, software, devices, and platform regulation.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.cnbc.com/personal-finance/): Consumer money news on taxes, retirement, debt, savings, and spending.

## Markets & Investing
- [Market Data](https://www.cnbc.com/market-data/): Quotes, charts, screeners, and performance data for major asset classes.
- [Stocks](https://www.cnbc.com/stocks/): Stock market news, movers, earnings reactions, and company-specific coverage.
- [Pro](https://www.cnbc.com/pro/): Subscriber-focused investing analysis, trade ideas, and market commentary.
- [Investing Club](https://www.cnbc.com/investingclub/): Jim Cramer investing club updates, portfolio actions, and member analysis.
- [ETF Edge](https://www.cnbc.com/etf-edge/): ETF-focused news, interviews, and trends in fund investing.
- [Trading Nation](https://www.cnbc.com/trading-nation/): Trading-oriented market analysis and commentary on technical and macro themes.

## Economy, Policy & Finance
- [Finance](https://www.cnbc.com/finance/): Banking, Wall Street, credit, dealmaking, and financial services coverage.
- [Fed Rate Decision](https://www.cnbc.com/fed-rate-decision/): Coverage of Federal Reserve meetings, rates, and policy implications.
- [Wealth](https://www.cnbc.com/wealth/): High-net-worth finance, family offices, luxury markets, and wealth management.
- [Taxes](https://www.cnbc.com/taxes/): Tax policy, filing guidance, IRS updates, and taxpayer planning news.
- [Retirement](https://www.cnbc.com/retirement/): Retirement savings, Social Security, pensions, and later-life planning coverage.
- [Make It](https://www.cnbc.com/make-it/): Career, money, entrepreneurship, and work-life advice for consumers and professionals.

## Industries
- [Healthcare](https://www.cnbc.com/healthcare/): Healthcare business news, insurers, hospitals, biotech, and medical innovation.
- [Health and Science](https://www.cnbc.com/health-and-science/): Public health, pharma, biotech, and science reporting.
- [Energy](https://www.cnbc.com/energy/): Oil, gas, utilities, renewables, and energy market developments.
- [Media](https://www.cnbc.com/media/): Streaming, advertising, entertainment, telecom, and media company news.
- [Transportation](https://www.cnbc.com/transportation/): Airlines, autos, EVs, logistics, shipping, and travel infrastructure coverage.
- [Real Estate](https://www.cnbc.com/real-estate/): Housing, mortgages, commercial property, and homebuilder news.
- [Retail](https://www.cnbc.com/retail/): Retailers, consumer brands, e-commerce, and shopping trend coverage.

## Technology & Emerging Themes
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.cnbc.com/artificial-intelligence/): AI company news, model launches, regulation, and enterprise adoption.
- [Cryptocurrency](https://www.cnbc.com/cryptocurrency/): Bitcoin, crypto markets, exchanges, regulation, and blockchain business news.
- [Venture Capital](https://www.cnbc.com/venture-capital/): Startup funding, investors, unicorns, and venture ecosystem reporting.
- [Sustainable Future](https://www.cnbc.com/sustainable-future/): Climate, clean energy, ESG, and sustainability-focused business coverage.
- [CNBC Disruptor 50](https://www.cnbc.com/disruptors/): Annual ranking and reporting on influential private growth companies.
- [Work](https://www.cnbc.com/work/): Workplace trends, management, labor, and employment-related business coverage.

## Video & TV
- [Video](https://www.cnbc.com/video/): CNBC video clips, interviews, market updates, and show segments.
- [Live TV](https://www.cnbc.com/live-tv/): Live stream access and schedules for CNBC television programming.
- [TV Schedule](https://www.cnbc.com/tv/): Program listings and information for CNBC shows and airtimes.
- [Mad Money with Jim Cramer](https://www.cnbc.com/mad-money/): Show clips, commentary, and stock-focused segments from Mad Money.
- [Squawk Box](https://www.cnbc.com/squawk-box-us/): Morning market show coverage, interviews, and featured segments.
- [Closing Bell](https://www.cnbc.com/closing-bell/): End-of-day market coverage, interviews, and trading analysis.
- [Fast Money](https://www.cnbc.com/fast-money/): Trader panel commentary and rapid market analysis from the Fast Money franchise.

## Special Reports & Editorial Franchises
- [CNBC Investigations](https://www.cnbc.com/cnbc-investigations/): Investigative reporting on corporate conduct, fraud, and systemic business issues.
- [Inside India](https://www.cnbc.com/inside-india/): Reporting and analysis focused on India’s economy, markets, and companies.
- [Inside China](https://www.cnbc.com/inside-china/): Coverage of China’s economy, policy, markets, and corporate developments.
- [Inside Wealth](https://www.cnbc.com/inside-wealth/): Reporting on affluent consumers, luxury, and wealth trends.
- [Small Business Playbook](https://www.cnbc.com/small-business-playbook/): News and advice for entrepreneurs and small business operators.
- [Your Money](https://www.cnbc.com/your-money/): Consumer-focused money reporting on saving, spending, and financial decisions.

## Newsletters & Products
- [Newsletters](https://www.cnbc.com/newsletters/): Email newsletters covering markets, politics, technology, and personal finance topics.
- [CNBC Pro](https://www.cnbc.com/pro/): Premium subscription product for deeper investing analysis and market insights.
- [Investing Club](https://www.cnbc.com/investingclub/): Membership product centered on Jim Cramer’s charitable trust portfolio.
- [Make It](https://www.cnbc.com/make-it/): Consumer-focused product area for careers, money, and success stories.
- [Select](https://www.cnbc.com/select/): Product reviews and personal finance recommendations for cards, banking, and insurance.

## About & Corporate
- [About CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/world/?region=world): Global CNBC landing page with international business news and network context.
- [Digital Products](https://www.cnbc.com/digital-products/): Overview of CNBC digital offerings, subscriptions, apps, and platforms.
- [Site Map](https://www.cnbc.com/site-map/): Structured index of CNBC sections, topics, and navigational links.
- [Closed Captioning](https://www.cnbc.com/closed-captioning/): Information about captioning support for CNBC programming.
- [Corrections](https://www.cnbc.com/corrections/): Published corrections and editorial updates to CNBC reporting.
- [Contact](https://www.cnbc.com/contact/): Contact information for newsroom, support, and general inquiries.
